y-m-29-08.title: Mutsetse unogovana mapoinzi mangani ne parabola?
y-m-29-08.topic: Ma graph e quadratic function nemitsetse: huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana nekukosha kwe k
y-m-29-08.goal: Yedza pfungwa 'inoshanda mumienzaniso mishoma, saka inogara ichishanda' panzvimbo apo kukosha kunochinja, gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso ine mapoinzi ekupindirana 2, uye utsanangure nekukosha kudiki zvikuru kuti nei pane poinzi 1 yekupindirana kana pasina.
y-m-29-08.material:
Dhirowa parabola y=x² nemutsetse y=2x+k pa coordinate plane imwe chete. k inhamba inosarudza y-coordinate yepoinzi apo mutsetse unosangana ne y-axis. (y=2x+k inoverengwa se 'y inoenzana ne two x plus k', uye x²-2x inoverengwa se 'x squared minus two x'.) Ma x-coordinate emapoinzi ekupindirana e ma graph maviri ndiwo x anogutsa x²=2x+k, ndiko kuti, x²-2x=k. Pazasi ndiyo tafura yemakosha e x²-2x. Verenga tafura nenzira yakachinjika.
  x       | -2 | -1 |  0 |  1 |  2 |  3 |  4
  x²-2x   |  8 |  3 |  0 | -1 |  0 |  3 |  8
y-m-29-08.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti nei huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana hunochinja
y-m-29-08.prereq.0: Graph ye quadratic function y=x² netafura yemakosha e ma expression senge x²-2x (nhanho ye middle school grade 3)
y-m-29-08.prereq.1: X-coordinate yepoinzi yekupindirana ndiyo x apo makosha e y e ma expression maviri anova akaenzana
y-m-29-08.s.s1.prompt: Mutafura, kana k=3 ma x-coordinate emapoinzi ekupindirana ndi -1 ne3, uye kana k=0 ndi0 ne2, saka pane mapoinzi ekupindirana 2 munyaya dzose mbiri. Minjun anofunga, 'Chero k iri nhamba ipi, mutsetse y=2x+k unosangana ne parabola pamapoinzi 2.' Nzira yakanakisa yekuyedza pfungwa yaMinjun ndeipi?
y-m-29-08.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga makosha e x²-2x mutafura kubva kuruboshwe kuenda kurudyi uye utarise kuti makosha anochinja sei (anoramba achikura, kana anochinja nzira).
y-m-29-08.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza makosha mashoma e k, verenga kuti ma x mangani mutafura anogutsa x²-2x=k, uye uenzanise nenzira pfupi kuti k iri papi kana huwandu huchichinja.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.a: Sarudza uye uyedze ma natural number madiki mashoma asiri mutafura, senge k=1, k=2, k=5
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.a: Kuyedza kwakanaka, asi hapana chiyero chekuti utarise chii kana uchisarudza makosha. Kutanga tsvaga pakachinja makosha mutafura.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.b: Sarudza uye uyedze k padhuze napo makosha ari mutafura anodzika wobva akwira zvakare (-1 kana -2)
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakatora sechiratidzo kuti nzvimbo ine kukosha kudiki zvikuru mutafura ndiyo pangachinja huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.c: Mienzaniso yose mbiri yaiva 2, saka zvakakwana, uye bvuma pfungwa yaMinjun sezvayakaita
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.c: Wakataura 'chero nhamba' kubva pamienzaniso mishoma. Pangava nemarudzi e k asati aedzwa.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.d: Yedza makosha mashoma e k makuru kupfuura tafura, senge k=8, k=15, k=24
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.d: Uri kungowedzera makosha erudzi rumwe chete (k hombe). Tarisa kuti makosha e x²-2x anochinja sei mutafura.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.explain: Kuwedzera mienzaniso yerudzi rumwe chete hakuzogadzira muenzaniso unopikisa. Huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana hunogona kuchinja padhuze napo kukosha kwe x²-2x kuri kudiki zvikuru (-1 kana x=1 mutafura). Saka kusarudza k padhuze nekukosha ikoko, senge k=-1 kana k=-2, nekutarisa ndiko kuyedza chaiko. Ngatitsanangurei chikonzero muhanho yekupedzisira.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga makosha matatu akasiyana e k apo mutsetse ne parabola zvinosangana pamapoinzi 2 chaizvo uye ma x-coordinate emapoinzi ose maviri ekupindirana ndema integer. Isa k nema x-coordinate x₁ ne x₂ emapoinzi maviri ekupindirana. (x₁ ne x₂ ndema integer kubva ku-9 kusvika ku9.)
y-m-29-08.s.s2.hint.0: Mutafura, tsvaga mitsara apo kukosha kumwe chete kunoonekwa kaviri, uye unyore kukosha ikoko se k uye makosha e x panguva iyoyo se x₁ ne x₂.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.hint.1: Isa k yawakawana mu x²=2x+k uye uverenge zvakananga kuti ma x ose maviri akarurama.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.ok.c1: k, x₁, ne x₂ ndema integer anosangana nemamiriro.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Ita k, x₁, ne x₂ ma integer uye ita x₁ ne x₂ kubva ku-9 kusvika ku9.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Ma x-coordinate emapoinzi maviri ekupindirana akasiyana kune mumwe nemumwe.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana x₁ ne x₂ dzakafanana, pane poinzi imwe yekupindirana. Nyora makosha maviri akasiyana.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Ma x-coordinate ose maviri anogutsa x²=2x+k.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.fail.c3: x₁ kana x₂ haigutsi x²=2x+k. Isa zvakananga uye uenzanise mativi ose maviri.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.explain: Tsvaga mitsara mutafura apo kukosha kumwe chete kunoonekwa kaviri: kukosha 0 kuri pa x=0 ne2, kukosha 3 kuri pa x=-1 ne3, uye kukosha 8 kuri pa x=-2 ne4. Kunze kweizvi, peya ipi neipi ye integer ine x₁+x₂=2 inoshanda (semuenzaniso x=-3 ne5 inopa k=15), uye mapoinzi maviri ekupindirana ari pachinhambwe chakafanana kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe x=1. Kuchinjanisa x₁ ne x₂ kunopa k imwe chete, saka imuenzaniso mumwe chete.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.prompt: Kana k=-1 pane poinzi 1 chete yekupindirana, uye kana k=-2 hapana. Tsanangura kuti nei, uchishandisa tafura (kana expression).
y-m-29-08.s.s3.hint.0: Mutafura, tsvaga idiki zvikuru pamakosha e x²-2x uye kuti inoitika pa x ipi.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti k=-1 ne k=-2 dzakaenzana kana dziri pasi pekukosha kudiki iko here, uye funga kuti pane x inogutsa x²-2x=k panguva iyoyo here.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakapa umbowo here kuti kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwe x²-2x ndi-1 kubva patafura (kana expression)?
y-m-29-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti k=-1 ne k=-2 imwe neimwe iri papi zvichienzaniswa nekukosha ikoko?
y-m-29-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakashandisa here hukama hwekuti 'ma x-coordinate emapoinzi ekupindirana ndiwo x anogutsa x²-2x=k'?
y-m-29-08.s.s3.model.0: Kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwe x²-2x ndi -1 kana x=1. Saka kana k=-1 dzinosangana pa x=1 chete, iyo ipoinzi imwe, uye k=-2 idiki kupfuura izvozvo, saka hapana poinzi apo dzinosangana.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.model.1: Mutafura, x²-2x haimbodzika pasi pe-1. Kana k=-1, x=1 chete inoshanda, uye kune k=-2 hapana x inoshanda, saka hapana poinzi yekusangana.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.model.2: x²-2x=(x-1)²-1, saka haigoni kuva pasi pe-1. Saka k=-1 inosangana panzvimbo imwe chete, x=1, uye k=-2 haina solution.

y-m-29-01.title: Purani ipi inokodzera zvakanaka mudiki wangu?
y-m-29-01.topic: Kushandisa linear functions: kuenzanisa mapurani maviri nekushandiswa pamuganhu
y-m-29-01.goal: Taura huwandu huviri hunokura nemwero wakagara, sezvinobhadharwa, nemalinear functions, nzwisisa kuti kuti rinhi rinodhura zvishoma kunogona kuenderana nekushandiswa, gadzirisa kutonga kwako nekuvimba kwako nguva imwe neimwe data itsva painouya, uye ugadzire wega purani itsva inokodzera mamiriro.
y-m-29-01.material:
Mudiki wangu anoda kusarudza purani yedata yefoni. Kana kushandiswa kwemwedzi kuri x GB (nhamba i0 kana kupfuura, madhesimali anogoneka), mutengo wemwedzi y (원) wemapurani maviri uri sezvinotevera.
Purani A: mutengo wekutanga 3000원 + 500원 pa1GB, ndiko kuti, y=500x+3000
Purani B: mutengo wekutanga 6000원 + 300원 pa1GB, ndiko kuti, y=300x+6000
(y=500x+3000 inoverengwa se 'y equals five hundred x plus three thousand'. Fungidzira kuti mutengo pa1GB hauchinji kunyange kushandiswa kuri kukuru. Mari idzi dzakagadzirwa.)

y-m-29-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora mari mbiri dzakaverengwa padivi pedzimwe pakushandiswa kwega kwega, uye utarise kana kuti ndeipi inodhura zvishoma kunochinja kushandiswa kuchiwedzera.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Parizvino zvirevo zvehurongwa huviri chete ndizvo zvinozikanwa. Hauzivi zvakadini data inoshandiswa nehama yako pamwedzi.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Hurongwa hupi hwaunogona kutaura kuti hunokodzera hama yako zvakanaka?
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.after: A ine mubhadharo wokutanga wakaderera uye mari yakakwirira pa 1GB, uye B yakapesana. Kana zvakapindirana nenzira iyi, divi rakanaka rinogona kusiyana kana kushandiswa kuri kudiki nekana kuri kukuru. Sezvo usingazivi kushandiswa parizvino, zvakaoma kusarudza.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: A, ine mubhadharo wokutanga unodhura zvishoma, inodhura zvishoma muzviitiko zvose pasinei nokushandiswa
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakaenzanisa chete mubhadharo wokutanga. Verenga zvakananga kuti mari mbiri dzakaita sei kana kushandiswa kuri kukuru zvikuru.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: B, ine mari inodhura zvishoma pa 1GB, inodhura zvishoma muzviitiko zvose pasinei nokushandiswa
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaenzanisa chete mari pa 1GB. Verenga mari mbiri kana kushandiswa kuri padhuze ne 0GB.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zvinogona kusiyana zvichienderana nokushandiswa, saka ndinogona kusarudza chete kana ndaziva kushandiswa

y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Pakupedzisira mari mbiri dzinova nehuwandu hwakafanana, saka hapana musiyano kunyange ukasarudza ipi
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kunyange paine kushandiswa apo dzakaenzana, pane kushandiswa kumwe kune musiyano. Verenga mari mbiri pakushandiswa kwakati wandei.

y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: B, ine mari inodhura zvishoma pa 1GB, yakanaka. Mutengo pachikamu unokosha zvakanyanya kupfuura mhedzisiro yemwedzi 3 yokuverenga

y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kushandiswa kwemwedzi mitatu kwakafanana, saka handigoni kutaura chinhu pamusoro pokuti ndeipi yakanaka
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Mumhando ye 8 kusvika 12GB, A yakaramba ichidhura zvishoma. Kana ukazvitaura nemhando, unogona kutonga.

y-m-29-03.title: Girafu ye (x-2)² yakafambiswa kuenda kudivi ripi?
y-m-29-03.topic: Magirafu emabasa quadratic: mafambiro ekutamisa mu y=a(x-p)²+q
y-m-29-03.goal: Tarisa kana mafambiro anosarudzwa nechimiro chechirevo chete anowirirana nekukosha kuri patafura, utonge mafambiro nokuenzanisa nzvimbo apo kukosha kwakaenzana, uye ushandise mutemo uyu kuchirevo chitsva.
y-m-29-03.material:
Haeun akataura kuti girafu ye y=(x-2)² yakafambiswa kuenda kudivi ripi kubva pagirafu ye y=x². 'Muchirevo, 2 yabvisirwa pa x, saka x yakaderera ne 2. Saka ndigirafu yakafambiswa kuruboshwe ne 2.' (y=(x-2)² inoverengwa 'y yakaenzana bhurakiti rakavhurwa x bvisa mbiri bhurakiti rakavharwa rakaitwa sikweya'. Kutamisa kunoreva kuti girafu yose inofamba ichichengeta chimiro chayo. Kuruboshwe ndiko kwakaderera x, uye kurudyi ndiko kwakakura x.) Haeun akagadzira tafura nokuisa nhamba pa x kutsvaga y. Verenga tafura zvakarara.

y-m-29-03.s.s1.o.a: Haeun akarurama. Muchirevo x yakaderera ne 2, saka yakafambira kudivi apo x iri diki, ndiko kuti, kuruboshwe ne 2
y-m-29-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakasarudza mafambiro nechimiro chechirevo (x-2) chete. Hauna kutarisa kana kukosha kuri patafura kunowirirana nemafambiro iwayo.

y-m-29-03.s.s1.o.c: X dzinopa kukosha 0, 1, ne 4 kwa y=x² dzose dzi 2 dzakakura muna y=(x-2)²
y-m-29-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakaenzanisa kana kukosha kwakati wandei kwakafambiswa nomutemo mumwe chete. Wakashandisa kufamba kwegirafu yose, kwete poinzi imwe, sehumbowo.
y-m-29-03.s.s1.o.d: Mapoinzi mashoma patafura haangaratidzi mafambiro, saka haugoni kutonga kusvikira wadhirowa girafu
y-m-29-03.s.s1.r.d: Iyi ipfungwa inonyatsongwarira yokuti zvakaoma kuva nechokwadi kubva pamapoinzi mashoma. Asi kana kukosha kwakati wandei patafura kwakafambiswa nomutemo mumwe chete, humbowo hunounganidzwa. Edza kuenzanisa nzvimbo dzekukosha 0, 1, ne 4.
y-m-29-03.s.s1.explain: Mu y=x², kukosha 0 kunoitika pa x=0, kukosha 1 pa x=±1, uye kukosha 4 pa x=±2. Mu y=(x-2)², kukosha 0 kunoitika pa x=2, kukosha 1 pa x=1 ne 3, uye kukosha 4 pa x=0 ne 4. Dzose dziri 2 kurudyi (kudivi apo x inokura). Mafambiro aHaeun haawirirani netafura. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti x inofanira kuva 2 yakakura kuti iwane kukosha kwa y kumwe chete.

y-m-29-06.title: Upamhi hwe parabola hunochinja sei kana a ichichinja?
y-m-29-06.topic: Quadratic function y=ax²: simbi nehukuru hwe a zvinokanganisa sei graph
y-m-29-06.goal: Tonga danho nedanho, uchibva pamitengo iri mumatebhura, kuti hukuru nesimbi ye a mu y=ax² zvinokanganisa sei upamhi nenzira yekuvhurika, uye uwane counterexample uye unyore zvakare mutemo.

Upamhi hwe parabola hunotsanangurwa sedhuri pakati pepoinzi yekuruboshwe nepoinzi yekurudyi pahukuru hwekukwirira hwakafanana (absolute value ye y). Sua anofunga, 'Painonyanya kukura a, ndipo painonyanya kupfupika upamhi.' Ngatitarise kana pfungwa iyi yakarurama nekutarisa matebhura rimwe panguva.
